mapper.select: /* banrInqyDao1010 : 배너 시퀀스 조회 */ SELECT 'BANR_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(BANR_CD,'BANR_')),0) + 1,4,0) AS SEQUENCE_ID FROM BANR

/* banrInqyDao1020 : 배너 조회 */ SELECT B.BANR_ID , B.BANR_NM , TO_CHAR(B.BANR_SDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BANR_SDT , TO_CHAR(B.BANR_EDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BANR_EDT , B.BANR_URL , B.USE_YN , B.FILE_ID , B.REG_IDX , TO_CHAR(B.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT , B.DISP_ORDER , B.REMARK , F.FILE_SNO , F.FILE_NM , F.SAVE_FILE_NM , F.FILETYPE_CD , F.FILE_PATH , F.FILE_EXT , F.FILE_SIZE , E.EMP_NM , E.ORG_CD , O.ORG_NM FROM BANR B LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_INFO F ON F.FILE_ID = B.FILE_ID AND F.FILETYPE_CD = 'BANR' AND F.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = B.REG_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD WHERE 1=1
AND B.BANR_ID = #{banrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* banrInqyDao1030 : 배너 조회 (메인) */ SELECT B.BANR_ID , B.BANR_NM , TO_CHAR(B.BANR_SDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BANR_SDT , TO_CHAR(B.BANR_EDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BANR_EDT , B.BANR_URL , B.USE_YN , B.FILE_ID , B.DISP_ORDER , F.FILE_SNO , F.FILE_NM , F.SAVE_FILE_NM , F.FILETYPE_CD , F.FILE_PATH , F.FILE_EXT , F.FILE_SIZE FROM BANR B INNER JOIN FILE_INFO F ON F.FILE_ID = B.FILE_ID AND F.FILETYPE_CD = 'BANR' AND F.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(B.BANR_SDT) AND TRUNC(B.BANR_EDT) ORDER BY B.DISP_ORDER ASC, B.BANR_ID ASC
mapper.insert: /* banrProcDao1010 : 배너 저장 (등록) 처리 */ INSERT INTO BANR ( BANR_ID , BANR_NM , BANR_SDT , BANR_EDT , BANR_URL , FILE_ID , REG_IDX , REG_DT , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( (SELECT 'BANR_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(BANR_ID, 'BANR_', ''))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM BANR) , #{banrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(#{banrSdt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{banrEdt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , #{banrUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{fileId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{regIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , SYSDATE , #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , (SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM BANR) , NULL )
